newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian police probe NZ boy's death.
newsitem.headline: Australian police probe NZ boy's death.

text.p: Australian police said on Sunday they were investigating the death of a nine-year-old New Zealand boy who fell from a train while apparently playing near an exit.
The body of Chey Steven Reberger, of Christchurch, was found by rail tracks about 150 km (90 miles) southwest of Sydney on Saturday, police said.
The boy, who was travelling with an aunt, had been missing since Friday night, when he left his seat to go the toilet.
A police spokesman said the death was being treated as accidental, adding it was likely the boy had been playing with an exit door and was somehow sucked out.
"We still don't know how it happened," he said.
